title: Sw-SSFCM_Dataset: benchmark scenes, label-budget splits and guidance-scale parameters for spatial-weighted semi-supervised fuzzy c-means on hyperspectral imagery
description: Reproducibility kit for the manuscript A novel approach to spatial-weighted semi-supervised fuzzy c-means clustering for hyperspectral image analysis (Computers & Geosciences). Contains the retrieval scripts for the six public hyperspectral benchmarks (Botswana, Kennedy Space Center, Indian Pines, Pavia University, Houston 2013, WHU-Hi-LongKou), a self-contained Python loader reproducing the exact preprocessing and label encoding of the paper, the 300 canonical semi-supervised splits (6 scenes x 5 label budgets x 10 draws) and the guidance-scale parameters of the theta-rule. The hyperspectral cubes themselves remain with their original providers and are not redistributed here.
